features:
- [ADB & MULTI-INSTANCE] Chuan hoa co che van hanh dong thoi va cap quyen kenh ADB Transport (TCP 5037), loai bo xung dot daemon giua cac phien ban tren cung may tram.
- [TELEMETRY & UI] Toi uu luong nhat ky thoi gian thuc (Compact Telemetry Stream) va chuan hoa thong diep chan doan tren cac module Change/Backup/Restore/Proxy, giam tai UI thread khi chay Phone Farm.
- [STABILITY & INTEGRITY] Cai thien do on dinh giao thuc Play Services handshake va kiem toan toan ven he sinh thai 11 Standalone DLL Modules.
